item_name: STMTrack (Fu et al., CVPR 2021) - space-time memory of observations instead of a single template
bibliography: Zhihong Fu, Qingjie Liu, Zehua Fu, Yunhong Wang. 'STMTrack: Template-free Visual Tracking with Space-time Memory Networks'. CVPR 2021, pp. 13774-13783. Preprint arXiv 2104.00324 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.00324; same study). Code: https://github.com/fzh0917/STMTrack (PyTorch, built on video_analyst; training code, GOT-10k and full-data models released; BSD-3-Clause).
full_text_checked: arXiv PDF full text read (Sections 3-4, Tables 1-9, Fig. 4). Supplementary material not checked. Repository README checked; code files not read.
task_and_output: Generic single-object tracking: given the first-frame box, output per frame a classification map, a centre-ness map and an anchor-free box regression (FCOS/SiamFC++ style); final output is one box per frame. No presence/absence output.
data_and_independent_videos: Training: TrackingNet, LaSOT train, GOT-10k train, ILSVRC VID/DET, COCO (GOT-10k-only training for the GOT-10k test). Evaluation on unseen test splits: OTB-2015 (100), TrackingNet test (511), GOT-10k test (180), LaSOT test (280), UAV123 (123), VOT2018 (60). Ablations on GOT-10k test (Tables 1, 3), OTB/TrackingNet/LaSOT (Table 2), TrackingNet (Table 4).
target_size_and_input_resolution: Square crop with side 4x the target box, resized to 289x289 for both memory and query frames; GoogLeNet backbone, 512-d features. Not applicable to grey hexal input.
frame_rate_and_camera_motion: Native benchmark frame rates; generic camera motion. Training samples T=3 frames within a 100-frame gap. Runs at 37 fps on a Tesla V100 (GOT-10k server).
detector_and_exemplar: No detector. Exemplar replaced by memory: first frame, previous frame and N-2 frames sampled one per uniform segment of history (N=6 at inference); each memory frame is accompanied by a foreground-background label map (1 inside the predicted/GT box, 0 elsewhere).
trainable_nodes_and_loss: Two separate GoogLeNet backbones (memory and query; stages 3-4 unfrozen after epoch 10), extra conv for the label map, 512-d projections, 7-layer classification and regression heads; trained end-to-end 20 epochs x 300k samples (27 h on 4 V100) with SiamFC++-style classification, centre-ness and IoU regression losses. Memory read itself has no parameters (softmax dot-product).
controls_seeds_splits: Ablations: shared vs separate backbones x with/without label map (Table 1, Table 2); number of training memory frames 1-4 (Table 3); number of inference memory frames 1,2,4,6,8,ALL (Table 4). Single run per setting, no seeds or intervals reported. No control on distractor-rich or absent-target subsets.
metrics_and_numbers: Table 1 (GOT-10k AO): shared/no label 0.591; separate/no label 0.568; shared/label 0.620; separate/label 0.642 - label map gives +2.9 and +7.4 AO points. Table 3 (training memory size, AO): 1: 0.629, 2: 0.624, 3: 0.642, 4: 0.627. Table 4 (TrackingNet AUC by inference memory size): 1: 79.1, 2: 79.3, 4: 80.2, 6: 80.3, 8: 80.2, ALL: 79.8 (fps 43.0 -> 6.5) - going from 1 to 6 memory frames gains only +1.2 AUC and using all frames is worse than 6. Main: GOT-10k AO 0.642 (Table 7), TrackingNet AUC 80.3 (Table 6), LaSOT AUC 0.606 (Fig. 4), OTB-2015 0.719 (Table 5), UAV123 0.647 (Table 8, below DiMP-50 0.654), VOT2018 EAO 0.447 (Table 9, below D3S/Ocean 0.489).
tested_conditions: Unseen videos: yes (benchmark test splits). Target absence: no (not reported; no absence output). Similar distractors: not reported (only motivation of the label map). Occlusion: not reported separately (partial occlusion argued qualitatively). Night or low light: not reported. Sequential operation on own predictions: yes (memory frames and label maps come from own past predictions at inference).
mechanism_summary: Published: every memory frame is encoded together with a box-shaped foreground label map; the query frame is encoded by a separate backbone; every query pixel attends (softmax over all T*H*W memory pixels) to memory features and the retrieved feature is concatenated to the query feature before classification/regression heads. Memory content is not gated: first, previous and uniformly sampled history frames, all based on own predictions. Benefit relies on features learned end-to-end with the label map. No modification proposed here beyond the note that our analogue would be an attention read over stored FlyVis activity maps with target masks.
transfer_limits: Needs end-to-end training of large appearance backbones on millions of RGB frames; our core is 734 parameters over 721 grey hexals and the readout is an online ridge model, so a learned pixel-level memory read would be a new learned head over FlyVis output (an application unless it is trained through the core). Crop 4x target vs our ~2x; no absence or refusal; memory written without quality check, so errors during loss would enter memory. Small inference-memory gain (+1.2 AUC from 1 to 6 frames, Table 4) and degradation with all frames match our own null results.
research_questions_addressed: 5.2: caution/direct evidence that adding more past observations to the target representation gives small gains and that unselected frames can hurt (Table 4 ALL < 6); foreground label maps (explicit target masking in memory) matter. 5.1, 5.3, 5.4: not addressed (no refusal, no core-through-readout analysis beyond standard end-to-end training, SOT only).
candidate_node_change: Not applicable as a next change: the only transferable element (label-map-conditioned memory read) is equivalent to the already-failed query memory (z13_query_memory_v1, C memory weight selected as 0) unless trained end-to-end through the FlyVis core, which is the 5.3 question covered by N03 (DiMP). No separate minimal check proposed.
strongest_objection: Memory gains are small even with rich RGB features and full end-to-end training (+1.2 AUC on TrackingNet), the memory has no write policy, no distractor or absence handling, and our two memory variants already failed their primary criteria; nothing here addresses the refusal bottleneck.
evidence_strength: Peer-reviewed (CVPR 2021), code and models public; ablations single-run without intervals; widely used baseline but no independent replication of the memory-size ablation found. Moderate as a generic SOT result, weak as guidance for our setting.
where_distinction_is_made: Only in the learned representation and the memory read (label maps tell the memory encoder which pixels are target); classification head scores; no separate decision for distractor, out-of-area or absence. Map maximum is taken as the target location without a presence test.
feature_dependence: Depends on rich RGB appearance features from two GoogLeNet backbones trained on large datasets; no evidence for small motion/brightness features.
difference_from_tried: Essentially no difference in principle from z13_observed_memory_v1 (bank of past observations) and z13_query_memory_v1 (query-dependent read of stored observation models). The only differences are end-to-end learning of the memory encoder with label maps and pixel-level attention, which for us would require training a new readout (and ideally the core) - not a new memory policy. Hence: explanation source, not a basis to repeat the experiment.
memory_write_policy: Every frame's own prediction is eligible; at inference memory = first frame + previous frame + one frame from each of N-2 uniform segments of history (N=6, offset 1/2); no quality or presence check.
distractor_representation: Implicit only (via background pixels labelled 0 in the label map and the loss).
loss_on_applied_decision: Loss on the classification/centre-ness/regression maps of the query frame, which is the applied box output for SOT; not on an association decision.
no_fly_control_equivalent: Not applicable for a next change; generic equivalent would be an appearance-memory re-identification (e.g., MASA embeddings averaged over past matched boxes) without FlyVis.
temporal_information_availability: Causal: only current and past frames; answer available at the current frame with no delay.
depth_level: Short screening. Loses: no write policy, no refusal/absence, no distractor-specific evidence, depends on end-to-end RGB training, and its mechanism coincides with our already-failed observation and query memories; small memory-size gains (Table 4) support the caution in synthesis. Does not move to full analysis.
